sin.name: retirement-run-by-code
sin.description: A handler, listener or tick builds the RetireAgent command, so the journal retires an agent by itself.
sin.rule: No code retires an agent by itself. RetireAgentSubcommand builds the command from the line a person or an agent ran, and UnusedHelperRetirements alone retires a read-only helper unused for the hours a person set (message 127366); at a run limit refuse and say to ask the person.
